create_DeepGemmFp8BlockScaledMMKernel: create a DeepGemmFp8BlockScaledMMKernel instance with an FP8ScaledMMLinearLayerConfig for FP8 block-scaled matrix multiplication
test_is_supported: test whether DeepGemmFp8BlockScaledMMKernel is supported on the current CUDA platform with Hopper or Blackwell GPUs
test_can_implement: test whether DeepGemmFp8BlockScaledMMKernel can implement a given config with bfloat16 output and group_shape (1,128)
run_process_weights_after_loading: run process_weights_after_loading to post-process FP8 weights using deepgemm_post_process_fp8_weight_block and replace layer parameters
run_apply_block_scaled_mm: run apply_block_scaled_mm to perform FP8 GEMM with input tensor A, weight tensor B, and their scales As and Bs
